items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: a friend of mine, Dan Armstrong, who is a guitar technician, hooked this thing up.

ctx.x: Do you recall the first reason you had to play the electric bass?

Yes. Because The Beatles came into existence and at the time I was doing a lot of club dates, weddings and bar mitzvahs and The Beatles hit hard, you know, very popular. And you want to keep getting gigs so I went out and bought a Hagstrom electric bass, took it on the gig you know, faked my way through it. And then I decided that maybe I could convert the acoustic bass so it would sound like an electric bass so I devised a magnetic pick-up and a friend of mine, Dan Armstrong, who is a guitar technician, hooked…
